Audit · sognos.com.au/solutions/finance-operations

Finance & Operations: what to fix before porting

Prod order: Hero → Problem (3) → Capabilities (6) → Experience → Platform → Microsoft ecosystem (4) → Works with → Booking widget → Powered-by logos → Stats → Promo banner. Copy below is live; graphics and data are illustrative; SUGGESTED marks new copy.

  • Missing on redesign

    No finance-operations entry in lib/constants.ts or lib/solutions-content.ts on the redesign branch, so /solutions/finance-operations 404s on preview. Prod has 8 solutions; redesign has 7.

  • Broken stats

    Prod shows “0× Faster Compliance Reporting” and “0% Quality Standard Compliance”: counters that never ran, and compliance claims that do not fit F&O. Drop.

  • Duplicate platform story

    “Built on Dynamics 365 Finance and SCM” and “One platform. Finance through to operations.” say the same thing twice, plus a “Powered by” logo carousel. Merge into one Platform section.

  • Off-topic blocks

    The “Field Service Innovations with Microsoft Dynamics” banner and a date-picker booking widget sit mid-page. Replace with the standard CTA (Book a Demo + Talk to Sales).

  • Proof without links

    Experience names St Vincent's, Hearing Australia and Genetic Technologies with no stories or detail. Confirm permission to name them; add story links when they exist.

  • Positioning

    F&O is a delivery service, not a product. Keep it a supporting solution: Works with links it back to SognosCare + SognosRoster.

  • No visuals

    Every section is text-only on prod. Options here add illustrative finance graphics (close tracker, P2P chain, KPIs) in the Frontline style.

Problem

Problem ASticky rail rows · navy (Solutions B)

The problem

What Finance & Operations solves

When finance, procurement and operational teams work across separate systems, every close, approval and decision takes more effort than it should.

  1. 01

    Too much manual work between systems

    Teams spend time reconciling spreadsheets, re-entering data and chasing information across different systems before they can act.

    Issue today
  2. 02

    Limited visibility across the operation

    Finance, purchasing, inventory and operational data sit in different places, making it difficult to understand costs, performance and what is happening right now.

    Issue today
  3. 03

    ERP that cannot keep pace

    Heavy customisation and ageing processes make change harder than it needs to be, from adding new services and entities to meeting new reporting and compliance requirements.

    Issue today
